newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: New Zealand shares close barely changed.
newsitem.headline: New Zealand shares close barely changed.

text.p: * New Zealand shares close flat in featureless trade
370 nil * Volume NZ$44.3 million. Futures +1 at 1,179 755 nil * Other movers - +6 +10
The New Zealand sharemarket closed little changed in featureless trading on Monday, brokers said.
The NZSE-40 Capital Index edged up 0.42 of a point to 2,352.36 with trading in Telecom of 2.1 million shares valued at $16.1 million dominating total turnover of $44.3 million.
"It was a listless, directionless Monday," said Tim Preston of brokerage ANZ Securities.
"It seems to be a little bit in no man's land waiting for something to push it either way. It is being underpinned by good offshore performances.
"Some say the election uncertainty is keeping some on the sideline, but another group of investors are saying they are not concerned either way it goes," Preston said.
Nationalist New Zealand First is negotiating with the conservative National Party and the centre-left Labour Party over the shape of the next government after an inconclusive election on October 12.

"It is a bit of a mixed bag. We are a bit short of major stories for the moment, now the Telecom result last week is out of the way. Forestry stocks are looking a bit toppy on overseas trends," Preston said.

He singled out good turnover in Corporate Investments, a six cent rise in Milburn NZ, and a rise of three cents in Infratil to $1.13 (on the back of firming share prices in its investments Trustpower and Port of Tauranga) as features in an otherwise dull market.
